steps.warehousesBody: Create a warehouse, then divide it into sections. Inside a section you can build a tree of pallets, shelves and bins that mirrors the real floor.
steps.productsBody: Add a product once, then receive and dispatch against it. Record a cost price to see stock value, or a unit weight to count a pile by weighing it.
steps.batchesBody: Receive under a lot code with an expiry date. On dispatch, FEFO automatically sends the soonest-to-expire stock out first.
steps.offlineBody: Everything is stored encrypted on this device, so the app keeps working in airplane mode. Reminders still ring on time.
